findings.description: Independent parse of the pinned EE Bulletin page enumerated 75 names across 15 headings and the Emeriti page yielded 7 EE-titled emeriti (Coffman, Diament, Meadows, Nowick, Schwartz, Stern, Yang); these 82 names exactly equal the required person set. Faculty Bulletin was scanned for every "Electrical" title: every hit maps to a required person (name variants only), so no omissions.

EE Bulletin spells the name "Xiaodang Wang"; Faculty Bulletin lists "Xiaodong Wang, Professor of Electrical Engineering". Treated as the same person (same rank/dept; identity merge is the collector's, not changed here).

Homayoon Beigi, Zoran Kostic and Xiang Meng (Professor/Associate Professor of Professional Practice) and David Vallancourt (Senior Lecturer in Discipline; Faculty Bulletin: "Teaching Professor of Electrical Engineering") are classified teaching and excluded. Alexander Gaeta, Paul Sajda and Henning Schulzrinne appear in the EE directory with another home department after the name and a Faculty Bulletin "Professor of Electrical Engineering" title; classified joint_secondary (included).

Adjunct Senior Associate / Adjunct Associate Research Scientists (Willner, Fratelli, Ko) carry both adjunct and research-scientist labels; recorded as adjunct. Staff Associate, Senior Research Scientist, Associate Research Scientists and Postdoctoral Research Scientists recorded as research_staff. All excluded either way. No announced incoming or start-date language appears on the pinned pages.
Faculty Members-at-Large and individual personal/lab profile pages were not part of the pinned captures; unit authority rests on the official Bulletin EE listing and Faculty Bulletin titles.
